headline: Masco Corporation Announces Date for Earnings Release and Conference Call for 2021 Fourth Quarter and Full-Year
summary: LIVONIA, Mich., January 04, 2022--(BUSINESS WIRE)--Masco Corporation (NYSE: MAS) announced today that it will hold a conference call regarding 2021 fourth quarter and full-year results on Tuesday, February 8, 2022, at 8:00 a.m. ET. The conference call will be hosted by Masco President and Chief Executive Officer Keith Allman. Participants in the call are asked to register five to ten minutes prior to the scheduled start time by dialing (844) 549-7577 and from outside the U.S. at (442) 275-1712.
